worn_dagger.name: Worn Dagger
worn_dagger.description: A short blade gone dull with use. Quick in quick hands.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting Bow
hunting_bow.description: Feeds a family. Also perforates goblins.

longbow.name: Longbow
longbow.description: Taller than most of its owners.

war_hammer.name: War Hammer
war_hammer.description: Subtle as a landslide, twice as convincing.

moon_wand.name: Moon Wand
moon_wand.description: Hums a little tune when the moon is out.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: A dependable blade of honest iron.

steel_axe.name: Steel Axe
steel_axe.description: Chops wood. Chops other things too.

shadow_dagger.name: Shadow Dagger
shadow_dagger.description: Light as a whisper, sharp as a grudge.

arch_staff.name: Archmage Staff
arch_staff.description: The amethyst on top is definitely watching you.

obsidian_blade.name: Obsidian Blade
obsidian_blade.description: Volcanic glass, sharper than regret and twice as dark.

starfall_staff.name: Starfall Staff
starfall_staff.description: A shard of a fallen star set in blackwood. The mountain's deep floors keep a few.

gale_longbow.name: Gale Longbow
gale_longbow.description: Strung with something that isn't gut. The arrows arrive before the sound.

moonsteel_dagger.name: Moonsteel Dagger
moonsteel_dagger.description: Pale as a winter moon and about as warm. It finds the gap in anything.

dragonbane.name: Dragonbane
dragonbane.description: Forged for exactly one purpose. You will know when.

mage_robe.name: Enchanted Robe
mage_robe.description: Woven with wards. Machine wash cold.

runic_armor.name: Runic Armor
runic_armor.description: Dwarven runes still glow when danger is near. They glow a lot down here.

traveler_cloak.name: Traveler's Cloak
traveler_cloak.description: Smells of campfires and long roads.

shadow_cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
shadow_cloak.description: The seamstress swears it was black when she started.

tower_shield.name: Tower Shield
tower_shield.description: Less a shield, more a portable wall.

potion_hp.name: Health Potion
potion_hp.description: Restores 25 HP. Tastes like cherries and regret.

greater_potion.name: Greater Health Potion
greater_potion.description: Restores 60 HP. Brewed strong for those who go below.

elixir.name: Elixir
elixir.description: Restores 30 HP and 20 MP. The merchant swears by it.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: Cures poison and restores 5 HP. Tastes like swamp, works like magic.

ember_salve.name: Ember Salve
ember_salve.description: Cures burning and restores 5 HP. Apply liberally, scream less.

bread.name: Bread Loaf
bread.description: Restores 8 HP. Slightly stale, fully edible.

apple.name: Apple
apple.description: Restores 6 HP. Keeps the cleric away.

forest_herb.name: Forest Herb
forest_herb.description: Bitter leaves the healers swear by. Foraged in the forest.

marsh_reed.name: Marsh Reed
marsh_reed.description: Hollow, mana-soaked stems from the sunken marsh.

ember_shard.name: Ember Shard
ember_shard.description: A pebble of the mountain's anger. Warm forever. Found in the ash fields.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.description: The tanner pays well for these.

imp_horn.name: Imp Horn
imp_horn.description: Still faintly warm. Collectors are weird.

gem.name: Flawless Emerald
gem.description: Worth a fortune to the right collector.

dragon_scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon_scale.description: Still warm. Proof of the deed.

lich_crown.name: Crown of the Deathless
lich_crown.description: Its previous owner has no further use for it. Probably.

reed_buckler.name: Reedwoven Buckler
reed_buckler.description: Marsh reeds woven tight enough to turn a blade. Crafted, never sold.

beast_cleaver.name: Beast Cleaver
beast_cleaver.description: Pelts and horn make a savage edge. Crafted, never sold.

emberwood_staff.name: Emberwood Staff
emberwood_staff.description: Ash-field shards bound in living wood. Crafted, never sold.

wyrmfang_dagger.name: Wyrmfang Dagger
wyrmfang_dagger.description: A dragon's scale honed to a whisper. Crafted, never sold.

scaled_mail.name: Scaled Mail
scaled_mail.description: Dragonscale over boiled hide. Crafted, never sold.

stamina_draught.name: Stamina Draught
stamina_draught.description: Bitter marsh brew that puts the wind back in you.

hunters_stew.name: Hunter's Stew
hunters_stew.description: Meat, herbs, and no questions asked.

dragon_tonic.name: Dragon Tonic
dragon_tonic.description: Brewed round a dragon's scale. One swallow and every wound and every spent breath comes back.

deep_root.name: Deep Root
deep_root.description: Old-forest heartwood, dense as stone. The Deepwood yields it grudgingly.

grave_moss.name: Grave Moss
grave_moss.description: It only grows where something is buried. The Mirefen is full of it.

troll_salve.name: Troll Salve
troll_salve.description: Regrows what you were sure was gone. Restores 80 HP.

deeproot_bow.name: Deeproot Bow
deeproot_bow.description: Heartwood bent to a killing curve. Crafted, never sold.

leather_cap.name: Leather Cap
leather_cap.description: Boiled leather. Keeps the rain and the smaller teeth out.

iron_helm.name: Iron Helm
iron_helm.description: Hilda's pattern: plain, dented once, trusted forever.

wyrm_visor.name: Wyrm Visor
wyrm_visor.description: Forged from a skull that once breathed fire at its wearer.

wool_gloves.name: Wool Gloves
wool_gloves.description: Warm. That is the whole review.

smith_gauntlets.name: Smith's Gauntlets
smith_gauntlets.description: Made to catch sparks; happy to catch blades.

runed_grips.name: Runed Grips
runed_grips.description: The stitching spells something. Scholars disagree on what.

worn_boots.name: Worn Boots
worn_boots.description: Someone walked far in these. Now it is your turn.

marchers_boots.name: Marcher's Boots
marchers_boots.description: Border-guard issue. The soles outlast the guards.

scaled_greaves.name: Scaled Greaves
scaled_greaves.description: Dragon scale from the knee down. Crafted, never sold.

furn_rug.name: Woven Rug
furn_rug.description: Crimson wool from the western looms. Ties the room together. Placed at home: +5% gold from every fight.

furn_plant.name: Potted Fern
furn_plant.description: Thrives on hearth-light and neglect. Placed at home: potions heal a tenth more.

furn_bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
furn_bookshelf.description: Mostly adventure stories. A few are even true. Placed at home: +5% XP from every fight.

furn_banner.name: Hero's Banner
furn_banner.description: Your colors on the wall, so nobody forgets whose house this is. Placed at home: +3% chance to strike a critical blow.

furn_candles.name: Candelabra
furn_candles.description: Three flames against the dark. Cozy, not haunted. Placed at home: your mana or stamina comes back a point faster.

furn_bench.name: Oak Bench
furn_bench.description: Seats two friends or one tired hero lying down. Placed at home: a night in your bed rests you for 10 more fights.

bone_charm.name: Bone Charm
bone_charm.description: A knuckle of something big, on a cord. It remembers being strong.

moon_pendant.name: Moon Pendant
moon_pendant.description: Cold silver that hums faintly at night. The mind runs clearer.

wolfstooth_collar.name: Wolfstooth Collar
wolfstooth_collar.description: Steeped in alchemy until the hunger soaked in. Crafted, never sold.

ring_of_clarity.name: Ring of Clarity
ring_of_clarity.description: A drop of glass with a thought caught inside.

quickstep_ring.name: Quickstep Ring
quickstep_ring.description: Light as a promise. Your feet believe it.

duelists_ring.name: Duelist's Ring
duelists_ring.description: Won in a duel, lost in a duel, won again. It knows the rhythm.

grave_ward.name: Grave Ward
grave_ward.description: A mantle of moss and scale that death declines to touch. Crafted, never sold.

chancellors_letter.name: The Chancellor's Letter
chancellors_letter.description: Sealed with the Crown's red wax, addressed to Elder Maren of Pixelheim. You were paid to carry it, not to read it.

letter_wenna.name: Letter to Old Wenna
letter_wenna.description: One of Maren's five, addressed to Old Wenna of Saltmere in a young woman's hand. Fifty years in a tin. A courier never reads the post.

letter_pell.name: Letter to Old Pell
letter_pell.description: One of Maren's five, addressed to "Pell, the boy with the canary", Blackiron. A courier never reads the post.

letter_hale.name: Letter to Captain Hale
letter_hale.description: One of Maren's five, addressed to Captain Hale of Greyhold and sealed with a thumbprint of soot. A courier never reads the post.

letter_aske.name: Letter to Aske
letter_aske.description: One of Maren's five, addressed to Aske, who keeps Liane's door on the Frostgate. A courier never reads the post.

greymaw_hood.name: Greymaw's Hood
greymaw_hood.description: Old Greymaw's grey head, worn as a hood. The forest goes quiet when you walk by. Hunted, never sold.

drowned_signet.name: Drowned Signet
drowned_signet.description: A knight's seal ring, a hundred years under the bog. It still remembers its oath. Hunted, never sold.

cinderscale_shield.name: Cinderscale Shield
cinderscale_shield.description: Cinderjaw's scales hammered over oak. It is still warm on the inside. Hunted, never sold.

mossback_maul.name: Mossback Maul
mossback_maul.description: The stone Mossback threw at you, on a handle. The moss keeps growing. Hunted, never sold.

gulp_tooth.name: Gulp's Gilded Tooth
gulp_tooth.description: One of Grandmother Gulp's gold teeth, on a chain. It bites, a little, when it is hungry. Hunted, never sold.

lamplighters_supper.name: Lamplighter's Sausages
lamplighters_supper.description: Restores 40 HP. Odo cooks them on the lamps' first night, and every night since.

fountain_roast.name: Fountain Day Roast
fountain_roast.description: Restores 60 HP and 10 MP. A whole bird, roasted the way the town did on the day the fountain first ran.

city_banquet.name: Banquet Ribs
city_banquet.description: Restores 100 HP and 30 MP. The city eats well, and Odo makes sure of it.

lamplit_blade.name: Lamplit Blade
lamplit_blade.description: Hilda's first sword for the Village, its fuller polished bright enough to read by.

fountain_guard.name: Fountain Guard
fountain_guard.description: A round shield in the town's blue, its rim beaten from the old gate's hinges.

city_plate.name: City Plate
city_plate.description: Hilda's masterwork: the city's crest on the breast, her mark inside the collar.

lantern_draught.name: Lantern Draught
lantern_draught.description: Restores 40 MP. It glows faintly in the bottle, which Vex insists is normal.

fountain_tonic.name: Fountain Tonic
fountain_tonic.description: Restores 50 HP and 20 MP. Drawn from the new fountain and brewed twice.

phoenix_draught.name: Phoenix Draught
phoenix_draught.description: Restores 120 HP. Vex won't say what's in it, only that it was hard to catch.

festival_pie.name: Festival Pie
festival_pie.description: Restores 50 HP. Baked for the festival, won at the ring toss, eaten far too fast.

sea_glass.name: Sea Glass
sea_glass.description: Green and frosted, washed smooth by the tide off Saltmere. Crafters prize it.

fresh_fish.name: Fresh Fish
fresh_fish.description: Restores 20 HP. Caught off Saltmere this morning, or near enough.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.description: A fat white pearl from the Saltmere shallows. Odo will want it; so will Mirelle.

old_boot.name: Old Boot
old_boot.description: Every fisher catches one. Nobody knows whose they were.

tams_ladle.name: Tam's Ladle
tams_ladle.description: A cook's ladle, black iron, the handle wrapped in sailcloth. Tam carried it on the climb fifty years ago, and the sea gave it back. One of the relics the five left behind.

oilskin_hood.name: Oilskin Hood
oilskin_hood.description: Waxed sailcloth, stiff with salt. The rain runs off it, and so do most crabs. Crafted, never sold.

oilskin_coat.name: Oilskin Coat
oilskin_coat.description: A fisher's long coat, oiled until the sea gives up on it. Crafted, never sold.

oilskin_gloves.name: Oilskin Gloves
oilskin_gloves.description: Fingerless, for the knots. Saltmere's net-menders swear by them. Crafted, never sold.

oilskin_boots.name: Oilskin Boots
oilskin_boots.description: Sealed at the seams with pitch. Your feet stay dry; nothing else does. Crafted, never sold.

saltwood_buckler.name: Saltwood Buckler
saltwood_buckler.description: Driftwood, bleached and banded with sea glass. Light enough to dance with. Crafted, never sold.

tidecutter.name: Tidecutter
tidecutter.description: A blade of sea-glass edge on a pearl grip. It hums like a shell held to the ear. Crafted, never sold.

blackiron_ore.name: Blackiron Ore
blackiron_ore.description: Dark, heavy, faintly warm. The Ember Seal was poured from this seam fifty years ago.

black_ingot.name: The Black Ingot
black_ingot.description: An ingot from the seam the Ember Seal was cast from, stamped with five marks. The five took a cartload; this one waited. One of the relics the five left behind.

canary.name: Pell's Canary
canary.description: A very small, very cross yellow bird. It wants to go home.

blackiron_helm.name: Blackiron Helm
blackiron_helm.description: Hammered from the seam's own iron, dark as a cellar. Crafted, never sold.

blackiron_plate.name: Blackiron Plate
blackiron_plate.description: Heavy enough to anchor a boat. Warm, somehow, even in snow. Crafted, never sold.

blackiron_gauntlets.name: Blackiron Gauntlets
blackiron_gauntlets.description: Knuckles like anvils. Crafted, never sold.

blackiron_sabatons.name: Blackiron Sabatons
blackiron_sabatons.description: Every step rings. Sneaking is for other people. Crafted, never sold.

blackiron_bulwark.name: Blackiron Bulwark
blackiron_bulwark.description: A door of black iron with a handle. Goblins have broken teeth on it. Crafted, never sold.

blackiron_axe.name: Blackiron Axe
blackiron_axe.description: The miners' axe, reforged for war. It bites like the cold. Crafted, never sold.

old_steel.name: Old Steel
old_steel.description: Broken blades and rusted mail from Greyhold's armoury. Good steel under the rust.

oskars_shield.name: Oskar's Shield
oskars_shield.description: A bronze-rimmed shield, dented and polished. Oskar left it at Greyhold when he climbed the mountain: "Keep it till I'm home." One of the relics the five left behind.

fenwicks_locket.name: Fenwick's Locket
fenwicks_locket.description: A small brass locket with a red stone. Inside, a girl's face, worn soft by a thumb.

warden_helm.name: Warden's Helm
warden_helm.description: Greyhold's old pattern: a steel cap, a slit to see by. Crafted, never sold.

warden_hauberk.name: Warden's Hauberk
warden_hauberk.description: Mail over padding, the way the fort's guard wore it. It moves with you. Crafted, never sold.

warden_gloves.name: Warden's Gauntlets
warden_gloves.description: Steel-backed and soft in the palm, for a sure grip on a wet hilt. Crafted, never sold.

warden_boots.name: Warden's Boots
warden_boots.description: Made for walking walls all night. Crafted, never sold.

warden_kite.name: Warden's Kite Shield
warden_kite.description: Long enough to kneel behind. Greyhold's tower is still painted on it, faintly. Crafted, never sold.

warden_longsword.name: Warden's Longsword
warden_longsword.description: Reforged from the garrison's broken blades. It remembers what it was for. Crafted, never sold.

frost_lily.name: Frost Lily
frost_lily.description: A pale flower that only opens in the snow. Vex says it keeps a spell cold.

yeti_fur.name: Yeti Fur
yeti_fur.description: Thick, white and warm, and it smells exactly like a yeti.

icefin.name: Icefin
icefin.description: Restores 35 HP. A pale fish from under the Frostgate ice. Sweet, and cold to the bone.

caravan_strongbox.name: Gunnar's Strongbox
caravan_strongbox.description: An iron-bound box with a caravan's mark. Something has chewed one corner.

lianes_lantern.name: Liane's Lantern
lianes_lantern.description: A brass storm-lantern, its glass etched with stars. Liane lit it the night before the climb so the five could find their way home. One of the relics the five left behind.

frost_hood.name: Frostweave Hood
frost_hood.description: Yeti fur lined with lily-woven cloth. Your thoughts stay sharp in the cold. Crafted, never sold.

frostweave_robe.name: Frostweave Robe
frostweave_robe.description: White as the pass and just as quiet. Spells cast in it come out crisp. Crafted, never sold.

frost_mitts.name: Frostweave Mitts
frost_mitts.description: Fingerless, so the hands can still shape a spell. Crafted, never sold.

frost_boots.name: Frostweave Boots
frost_boots.description: Fur boots that never slip on ice. Mostly. Crafted, never sold.

frost_ward.name: Rime Orb
frost_ward.description: A ball of ice that never melts, held in the off hand. Blows come slower near it. Crafted, never sold.

rime_staff.name: Rime Staff
rime_staff.description: A white staff tipped with frost lily ice. It hums when it's cold, which is always. Crafted, never sold.

marens_promise.name: Maren's Promise
marens_promise.description: A tarnished brooch with five marks, the last one hers. She wore it fifty years. It's a promise that someone would finish what the five started. The fifth relic.

smugglers_rum.name: Smugglers' Rum
smugglers_rum.description: A small cask stamped with a skull that someone has tried to scrape off. It sloshes ominously.

shaft_cheese.name: Shaft Cheese
shaft_cheese.description: A black-rinded cheese aged deep in the Blackiron shafts. It hums, faintly. Bram will be beside himself.

guard_badge.name: Greyhold Badge
guard_badge.description: A soldier's badge from Greyhold, the tower on it worn smooth by a thumb.

kings_signet.name: King's Signet
kings_signet.description: The old king's seal, bought back from a valley merchant. Pixelheim's own, for whoever saved it.

aegis_of_the_ash.name: Aegis of the Ash
aegis_of_the_ash.description: Forged from the beams that burned on the Night of Ash. Nothing gets through it twice.

everflask.name: Everflask
everflask.description: Vex's finest: a flask that brings everything back, every wound and every spent breath.

deep_crystal_5.name: Crystal of the Fifth Depth
deep_crystal_5.description: Warm to the touch, like something alive gave it up.

deep_crystal_10.name: Crystal of the Tenth Depth
deep_crystal_10.description: Cut from the warden's lair. It hums when you hold it near the stair.

deep_crystal_15.name: Crystal of the Fifteenth Depth
deep_crystal_15.description: Deeper than the mountain is tall. It glows in the dark of the shelf.

deep_crystal_20.name: Crystal of the Twentieth Depth
deep_crystal_20.description: The Hollow King wore a shard of it. Now it's yours.

deep_crystal_30.name: Crystal of the Thirtieth Depth
deep_crystal_30.description: Heavy for its size, and colder than snow.

deep_crystal_50.name: Crystal of the Fiftieth Depth
deep_crystal_50.description: From further down than anyone has a word for.

medal_ten_below.name: Medal of Ten Below
medal_ten_below.description: Struck for whoever comes back from the tenth depth. So far, that's you.

medal_thirty_below.name: Medal of Thirty Below
medal_thirty_below.description: The smith who struck it had to ask how to spell 'thirty'.

medal_every_bounty.name: Medal of Every Bounty
medal_every_bounty.description: The board is empty because of you.

medal_slayer.name: Medal of All Kinds
medal_slayer.description: Every family of monster knows your step.

medal_dressed.name: Medal of the Matched Set
medal_dressed.description: For looking the part, every piece of it.

medal_seen_all.name: Medal of the Full Bestiary
medal_seen_all.description: Every page of the codex, filled.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Frontline bruiser. High health and defense, hits hard with steel.

skills.name: Power Strike
skills.description: A crushing blow dealing heavy physical damage.

skills.name: Shield Slam
skills.description: A staggering bash that can stun the enemy for a turn.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.description: Reckless fury: massive damage, but it costs 8 HP.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Glass cannon. Fragile, but Fireball melts anything with a face.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Hurls a fireball for heavy magic damage.

skills.name: Ignite
skills.description: Sets the enemy ablaze, burning it for several turns.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.description: A blast of cold that can freeze the enemy solid.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Fast and sneaky. Quick on their feet, deadly with a backstab.

skills.name: Backstab
skills.description: Strikes a vital spot for heavy dexterity damage.

skills.name: Poison Blade
skills.description: A coated dagger that leaves the enemy poisoned.

skills.name: Shadowstep
skills.description: Vanish and reappear behind the enemy for a devastating strike.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Holy support. Sturdy enough, and Mend keeps you in the fight.
cleric.pitch: Holds the line, heals it too

skills.name: Mend
skills.description: Channels light to restore health.

skills.name: Smite
skills.description: Searing radiance burns the enemy.

skills.name: Sanctuary
skills.description: A ward of light that heals and purges all ailments.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Wilds-born archer. Fast on their feet, deadly from a distance.

skills.name: Aimed Shot
skills.description: A measured arrow to a weak point for heavy dexterity damage.

skills.name: Barbed Arrow
skills.description: A cruel arrowhead that leaves the wound poisoned.

skills.name: Rain of Arrows
skills.description: The sky darkens. Everything under it regrets something.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.description: Armored faith. Takes the hits, returns them blessed, mends the rest.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.description: A blessed blow of righteous strength.

skills.name: Lay on Hands
skills.description: Healing light through gauntleted palms.

skills.name: Consecrate
skills.description: Holy fire that clings: damage now, burning after.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Rot scholar. Frail, patient, and everything they touch keeps dying.

skills.name: Soul Bolt
skills.description: A lash of stolen life for heavy magic damage.

skills.name: Blight
skills.description: A creeping rot that poisons for several turns.

skills.name: Grave Chill
skills.description: The cold of the tomb: damage, and the enemy may freeze in fear.
